pre_run.reason: The mathematical definition already fails because there is no autonomous non-clock task-state evolution, so a pre-run rate cannot make this configuration real-time.

source_evidence.claim: Level 5 uses five neutral solids, a smaller target/probe, six observations, three rotations, a 1.5 span, three target observations and rotations, three views, and three moving views.
Full and simplified interaction surfaces are distinct, and the configured observation window is 0 ms with one frame.
The environment is synchronous and declares the same zero observation window and one-frame observation.
Generation uses a seeded static mirror, target geometry, and difficulty parameters; no autonomous process is created.
Slice observations synchronously compute records, update target-hit state, redraw, and update the HUD.
Rotation and simplified/full slice changes occur only from direct input handlers; there is no idle advancement.
Probe movement, damage, capture, and withdrawal are all driven by pointer events or an explicit capture click.
The only timer is failure-overlay cleanup after submission, not active task evolution.
The verifier replays an ordered event transcript and grades geometry, counts, damage, and extraction; it has no elapsed-time or timestamp condition.
